newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iraqi oil minister meets Spain industry ministry.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi oil minister meets Spain industry ministry.

text.p: Spain's industry ministry said it had held talks on Monday with Iraqi Oil Minister Amir Mohammed Rasheed during his trip to Madrid but declined to reveal the details of their meeting.
The Iraqi embassy in Madrid said Rasheed would hold a news conference on Tuesday at 1500 GMT in Madrid and his secretary said he would later travel to Vienna to attend an OPEC meeting.
Local agency EFE reported that Rasheed had also met executives at energy group Repsol to discuss plans to develop the Nassiriyah oil field in the central zone of Iraq.
Quoting Repsol sources, the agency said the energy group wanted to secure a dominant position in Iraq when the U.N. embargo is finally lifted.

"In this embargo situation, Iraq has already signed contracts with energy firms in China and Russia, while the French groups Elf and Total are on the point of signing contracts on two other fields," the agency quoted the source as saying.
No one was available at Repsol to comment.
Rasheed is also expected to meet Spain's ministers of foreign affairs and foreign trade during his trip.
